metadata.name: mstocks_core
metadata.description: mStocks Solana core program: roles, multiplier scheduling, pause, freeze and clawback for Token-2022 mints

instructions.name: freeze
docs: Token accounts to freeze are passed as remaining accounts.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin that governs `role` (`Config::role_admin`).

accounts.name: program
docs: Initialization is restricted to the upgrade authority so nobody can front-run the
deployment and install their own admin.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin that governs `role` (`Config::role_admin`); receives the rent.

instructions.name: set_default_account_state
docs: Admin-only policy switch: `frozen = true` makes new token accounts start frozen.

instructions.name: thaw
docs: Token accounts to thaw are passed as remaining accounts.

instructions.name: unregister_mint
docs: Admin-only correction of a registration made in error; only while the mint has no supply.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program upgrade authority can initialize

errors.name: SelfGrantNotAllowed
errors.msg: Admin cannot grant a role to itself

errors.name: AdminCannotOperate
errors.msg: Admin cannot perform operational actions

errors.name: NotPendingAdmin
errors.msg: No pending admin, or signer is not the pending admin

errors.name: MultiplierOutOfRange
errors.msg: Multiplier outside [1e9, 1e27] (1e18 fixed point)

errors.name: NoticeTooShort
errors.msg: Effective time is earlier than the minimum notice period

errors.name: EffectiveTooFar
errors.msg: Effective time is beyond the scheduling horizon

errors.name: NotToken2022
errors.msg: Mint is not owned by the Token-2022 program

errors.name: WrongDecimals
errors.msg: Mint must have 9 decimals

errors.name: MintAuthorityIsCore
errors.msg: Mint authority must belong to the CCIP pool, not this program

errors.name: WrongFreezeAuthority
errors.msg: Freeze authority must be the program authority PDA

errors.name: WrongScaledUiConfig
errors.msg: Scaled UI Amount extension missing or authority is not the program authority PDA

errors.name: WrongPausableConfig
errors.msg: Pausable extension missing or authority is not the program authority PDA

errors.name: WrongMetadataPointer
errors.msg: Metadata pointer must point at the mint itself and be controlled by the program authority PDA

errors.name: WrongTokenMetadata
errors.msg: Token metadata missing or update authority is not the program authority PDA

errors.name: WrongTransferHook
errors.msg: Transfer Hook must exist, be dormant, and be controlled by the configured hook authority

errors.name: WrongDefaultAccountState
errors.msg: Default Account State must exist and be Initialized

errors.name: WrongPermanentDelegate
errors.msg: Permanent delegate must be the program authority PDA

errors.name: MintMismatch
errors.msg: Account does not belong to the given registered mint

errors.name: BadRemainingAccounts
errors.msg: Remaining accounts are missing or malformed

errors.name: SameAccount
errors.msg: Source and destination must differ

errors.name: UnexpectedExtension
errors.msg: Mint carries an extension mStocks does not allow

errors.name: MultiplierTooPrecise
errors.msg: Multiplier has more than 15 significant digits

errors.name: ZeroMantleToken
errors.msg: Mantle token address must not be zero

errors.name: MintHasSupply
errors.msg: Only a mint with zero supply can be unregistered

errors.name: NotRoleAdmin
errors.msg: Signer is not the admin that governs this role

errors.name: AdminsMustDiffer
errors.msg: The admin and the compliance admin must be different

errors.name: RoleRetired
errors.msg: This role is retired and cannot be granted

errors.name: NotComplianceAdmin
errors.msg: Only the compliance admin can do this

errors.name: MintAuthorityIsProgram
errors.msg: A mint whose authority is a program address (the CCIP pool) cannot be unregistered

types.name: Config
docs: Two admins, split like Mantle's: `admin` mirrors the token and factory admin (multisig 1) and
governs the token roles and the mint registry; `compliance_admin` mirrors the compliance and
pause registries' admin (multisig 4) and governs the pause, freeze and clawback roles. Neither
ever operates. The account is never reallocated: a layout change needs a migration.

fields.name: admin
docs: Squads multisig (Mantle multisig 1). Grants/revokes the token roles, governs the mint registry.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin handover target.

fields.name: hook_authority
docs: Squads multisig that must hold every mint's (dormant) Transfer Hook authority.

fields.name: compliance_admin
docs: Squads multisig (Mantle multisig 4). Grants/revokes the compliance roles.

fields.name: pending_compliance_admin
docs: Two-step compliance admin handover target.

types.name: MantleTokenIndex
docs: `["mantle_token", mantle_token]`: the mint registered for a Mantle token. Its existence is what
stops a second mint from being registered for the same token.

types.name: MetadataField
docs: Token metadata field to update. `Key` covers additional metadata such as the ISIN.

types.name: MintState
docs: A mint the program has validated and is allowed to operate on.

fields.name: mantle_token
docs: The Mantle `ScaledToken` this mint mirrors.

types.name: RoleEntry
docs: Existence of `["role", role, member]` means `member` holds `role` (like Mantle's AccessControl).
